pick.name: Buffer (Free)
pick.what: Queue-based scheduler for LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Threads, YouTube Shorts, Mastodon and more, with AI Assistant and API
pick.why: Most generous mature free tier, multi-network, includes an API key so Claude Code can push drafts programmatically
pick.free_limits: Free: 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel at a time, 100 ideas, AI Assistant, 30-day insights, API 1,000 req/channel/mo; Essentials $5/channel/mo

alts.name: Typefully
alts.why: Best drafting UX and thread previews; free tier tiny; Creator $99/yr is the pay-later pick

alts.name: Postiz
alts.what: Open-source social scheduler (14+ networks) with MCP, CLI and API
alts.why: Best open-source/agent-native option; self-host is free but you must register your own developer apps per network and pay X's per-use API

candidates.name: Typefully
candidates.verdict: Best writing UX; small free cap

candidates.name: Postiz
candidates.verdict: OSS + MCP; heavy self-host + per-network app approvals

candidates.name: Native schedulers
candidates.verdict: LinkedIn and YouTube schedule natively for free

decision: Buffer Free covers three channels (LinkedIn, X, YouTube Shorts) at $0 with an API. Switch to Typefully Creator ($99/yr) if most of your output is X/LinkedIn threads, or self-host Postiz when you want agent-driven posting and accept the setup and X API costs.
details: X posting through any tool now rides X's pay-per-use API; Buffer free excludes X sent-post analytics (reported).

verify.note: Buffer Free confirmed: 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts/channel, 100 ideas, 30-day insights, API 1 key (1,000 req/channel/30d, 3,000 cap); Essentials $5/channel/mo ($60/yr).
